hints.help: PDF (.pdf), up to 5 MB. Letter (8.5 × 11 in) or A4 is recommended. Export searchable text with embedded fonts and images around 150 dpi for a readable, smaller file. Save your draft, then publish to update the public download. Editing the page text does not change the PDF.

JPG/JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB per image and 40 megapixels. Recommended: 1600–2400 pixels on the longest edge, original aspect ratio, sRGB color. WebP is a good choice for smaller files; PNG/WebP can preserve transparency. Convert HEIC, TIFF or RAW before uploading.

MP4 (.mp4), up to 25 MB. Recommended: 1280 × 720 (720p), original aspect ratio, 24–30 fps; H.264/AVC video (8-bit, 4:2:0) and AAC audio (96–128 kbps stereo), with fast start enabled. Convert MOV, HEVC/H.265 or ProRes before uploading. Prepare larger files separately or use a YouTube/Vimeo link. Playback starts on click and repeats; audio is preserved.
